instanceToken.description: This instance's token: the gateway identifies the caller by it (X-Instance-Token)

stateDir.description: Where sealed connection blobs are kept (inside the backed-up volume); they go to <stateDir>/connections

skillsDir.description: Where skill schemas from the gateway live (<skillsDir>/<skill>/schema.json); same as skill-state

workspaceDir.description: Workspace with USER.md, rewritten when a shared profile block changes; default <stateDir>/../workspace
